# ReeeeecallStudy — Product Context

> ReeeeecallStudy is a flashcard learning platform for students, language learners, and professionals. It is available on the web, iOS, and Android. Users can start with a free plan; paid plans raise card storage limits.

## Learning

The six flashcard study modes are:
1. SRS: cards are scheduled for spaced repetition based on learning history and recall ratings.
2. Sequential review: systematic revision of review cards.
3. Random: shuffled practice.
4. Sequential: study in order.
5. By date: time-based sorting.
6. Cramming: focused repetition until mastered.

SRS uses four recall ratings: Again, Hard, Good, and Easy. Intervals vary by card and performance; no fixed review schedule or retention outcome is guaranteed.

## AI Features

AI card generation can create templates, decks, and cards from a topic. AI quizzes include multiple-choice, short-answer, and written-response questions, with grading and explanations. These are separate from the six flashcard study modes.

AI features provide a daily free allowance. Beyond that allowance, usage draws on prepaid balance. The interface shows the charge before confirmation. The current allowance and charge appear in the product.

## Plans and Limits

Signing up provides access to SRS, the six flashcard study modes, statistics, and deck sharing. The free plan has a card storage limit. Paid plans raise the limit. Prices, limits, and available plans are maintained by the service and may change. Read the current pricing section on the homepage rather than assuming unlimited storage or that every AI operation is free.

## Decks and Sharing

Users organize cards in decks with custom fields, images, and text-to-speech settings. Import and export tools support CSV and JSON. Sharing supports Copy (duplicate), Subscribe (sync updates), and Snapshot (a frozen version). Public deck preview pages at /d/{listingId} show the deck description and sample cards without requiring login. Studying and managing decks require an account.

## Progress

The dashboard includes study activity, streaks, review forecasts, and progress statistics. These describe the user's activity; illustrative examples are not evidence of guaranteed learning outcomes.

## Languages and Learning Insights

The interface supports English (en), Korean (ko), Simplified Chinese (zh), Japanese (ja), Spanish (es), Vietnamese (vi), Thai (th), and Indonesian (id).

New Learning Insights articles are published in English and Korean. Older articles in other languages can remain available to readers, but their pages are excluded from search indexing under the current language policy. An article's translations depend on which languages actually exist for that article.

English article URL: https://reeeeecallstudy.xyz/insight/{slug}
Korean article URL: https://reeeeecallstudy.xyz/insight/{slug}?lang=ko

Insights cover spaced repetition, active recall, learning techniques, language study, and exam preparation. Articles provide educational guidance; verify exam-specific facts against the examination body's current official materials.
